[{"insert":"Barbell Bent Over Row Progression

Back to the barbell bent over row with reps dropping to 10, 8, and 6 across the three working sets. Lower reps mean heavier weight on the back and posterior chain while holding the hinge position. Keep the torso angle consistent between sets and drive the elbows back rather than pulling with the hands. Use your Week 3 working weights as a starting point and increase where you can.
"}]
